title: PROMPT PULSE STAYS BRIGHT
why: Critic on 52 and 55: the press any key prompt reads dim. The pulse dipped to 0.6; now 0.85.
now: The press any key prompt on end cards stays bright through its pulse.

edits.replacement: @keyframes attpulse{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.85}}';   // v34.xx (cw-endpulse), the critic on 52 and 55: "press any key is small and dim grey" (the shot caught the pulse at .6): the faint end is .85 now
